mantis_teardown.caption:
What's inside the fastest punch in the sea? 🦐

A real 3D scan of a peacock mantis shrimp, taken apart piece by piece. A muscle charges slowly, a saddle-shaped spring stores the energy, a latch lets go: the club hits at 23 m/s (10,400 g) and even the collapsing bubble hits again.

Follow for more satisfying 3D teardowns.

3D model: "Mantis Shrimp (for the ScubaVerse)" by Drone-Services.Biz (sketchfab.com/MKSZ), CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). Science: Patek et al. 2004, 2007.
